rules.reason: Gradle owns wrapper scripts, the binary and the verified distribution.
The JDK feature and exact Node release have their own version syntax.
npm owns lock formatting. Check JSON, manifest agreement and registry integrity.
GSD plans and feasibility records contain machine-readable blocks, tables and evidence. Preserve their Markdown bytes within lines and verify UTF-8 and line endings.
ktfmt owns Kotlin, KDoc and Gradle Kotlin DSL. detekt checks comments.
Ruff formats Python and checks lint after formatting.
Taplo formats and checks TOML syntax and duplicate keys.
Preserve shell bytes and check syntax without executing scripts.
Prettier formats authored Markdown, browser assets and structured text. Steiger checks authored FSD source.

default.reason: Other tracked files must be UTF-8 text with LF, a terminal newline and no trailing horizontal whitespace. Generated output and caches are ignored by Git.
